programs.title: One Way Mirror
programs.desc: Professional soldier Skylar Nemetz claims he has a momentary lapse in gun safety that lead to his wife Danielle's tragic death; authorities aren't buying that someone with his level of training could accidentally forget to do some basic gun care.

programs.title: One Way Mirror
programs.desc: Police finds a new mother murdered soon after reported missing; they bring her partner and his best friend in to be interrogated about her final night; not every interrogation method works with every suspect, and not every theory proves true.

programs.title: Finally Caught
programs.desc: On Halloween night, Erik Poltorak opens his door, unaware of the danger awaiting him; what happens next leaves detectives struggling to unravel a carefully laid plan.

programs.title: Emily
programs.desc: Emily Brontë struggles within the confines of her life, yearning for artistic and personal freedom. She finds romance before writing her seminal novel, "Wuthering Heights.".

programs.title: Home Free
programs.desc: Herb and Audry have had a near perfect relationship for over fifty years. This anniversary Herb has a few surprises in store for his three estranged daughters. Herb, having recently been diagnosed with a fatal brain tumour, announces that he is choosing to die on his own terms and is not seeking treatment. As the daughters grapple with one another and wrestle their own demons, their father's condition worsens, and Audry realizes that she's not ready to say goodbye to her true love.

programs.title: Fog of War
programs.desc: At the height of WWII, a couple stranded on a remote estate become aware of a Nazi spy hiding among them. Unsure who to trust, they must uncover the spy's identity as the outcome of the war hangs precariously in the balance.
